notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token with haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
